cues.sfx_prompt: Heavy frameless tempered glass boardroom door swinging shut with a muted brushed-steel hydraulic latch click inside a quiet Sand Hill Road office suite, pure foley, no human voice
cues.director_note: 沙丘路顶层玻璃会议室液压闭锁，隔绝走廊杂音

cues.text: [icy polite] Appreciate you flying straight from Shenzhen, Lin. [measured] Before we wire a hundred and fifty million into NovaEdge, my partners need one clean answer.
cues.subtitle_translation: 谢你直接从深圳飞过来，林。在我们向灵犀智造打出一亿五千万美元之前，我的合伙人们只需要一个干脆的答案。
cues.director_note: 丝绸包钢，起手先给礼貌温差

cues.sfx_prompt: Thick bound term-sheet dossier sliding briskly across a polished walnut conference table followed by a solid fountain pen cap snapping shut on heavyweight cardstock, pure foley, no human voice
cues.director_note: 红线修订版条款清单沿胡桃木长桌推到林沉面前

cues.text: [coldly] Your audited filing shows an eighty-million-dollar loss last quarter. [skeptical] At a one-point-two-billion pre-money, we need a thirty percent haircut before sunrise.
cues.subtitle_translation: 你们审计底稿显示上季度亏了八千万美元。按十二亿投前估值算，天亮前你得先接受三成估值砍价。
cues.director_note: 负间隔接林沉冷峻截断，营造真实董事会抢话

cues.text: [interrupting] [measured] Stop calling it an operating loss, Victoria. [blunt] That eighty-million-dollar line is a phantom number, and your diligence team already knows it.
cues.subtitle_translation: 别再叫它经营亏损了，维多利亚。那行八千万美元的数字纯粹是个账面幽灵数字，你们尽调团队心里门儿清。
cues.director_note: Viral Clip A 0-3s 钩子：压低声线直切核心反杀

cues.text: [interrupting] [icy polite] Really? Because the auditors signed it in black ink, Lin. [coldly] Markets do not treat eighty million in red ink as fiction.
cues.subtitle_translation: 真的吗？可审计师是用黑字白纸签了名的，林。资本市场可不会把八千万赤字当成小说。

cues.text: [firmly] Two years ago we issued convertible notes to our cloud partner. [measured] When our valuation tripled, accounting rules marked those notes up on the balance sheet.
cues.subtitle_translation: 两年前我们向云端基础设施伙伴发过可转债。后来公司估值翻了三倍，会计准则就得把可转债公允价值重估记在资产负债表上。

cues.text: [blunt] That revaluation flowed through into the income statement on paper only. [firmly] It was not a cash loss. Not one dollar left our operating account.
cues.subtitle_translation: 那笔重估仅仅是在账面上流进了利润表。它根本不是现金亏损，我们经营账户里一分钱都没流出去。
cues.director_note: 咬死 flowed through into the income statement 与 not a cash loss

cues.text: [interrupting] [skeptical] Clever accounting defense. [measured] Still, hardware peers bleed out on inventory every single quarter.
cues.subtitle_translation: 很聪明的会计辩护。但就算如此，硬件同行每个季度都在库存上疯狂失血。

cues.text: [confident] Look at tab three, Victoria. Your burn thesis just got completely refuted. [measured] We shipped forty thousand units on half our rivals' spend—we are an extraordinarily capital-efficient business.
cues.subtitle_translation: 翻到第三页，维多利亚。你们关于烧钱的论断刚刚被彻底推翻了。我们花竞争对手一半的钱出了四万台货——我们是一家资本效率极高的公司。
cues.director_note: Viral Clip A 收尾反杀高点

cues.text: [understated] [short pause] Fair enough on the bridge note. [icy polite] Which is exactly why I invited London into the room before we sign.
cues.subtitle_translation: 好吧，可转债这笔账算你过关。但也正因为如此，签约前我才专门把伦敦那边请进了会议室。

cues.sfx_prompt: Crisp minimalist titanium smart-glasses temple haptic tap followed by a subtle ultra-clean low-latency micro-chime and soft optical shutter pulse in close stereo proximity, pure foley, no human voice
cues.director_note: 林沉轻触钛合金镜腿切换数据面板

cues.text: [guarded] Lin, procedural flag—Apex Horizon added Alistair Finch as commercial observer without forty-eight hours notice. [blunt] We do not owe him unit-level cloud invoices.
cues.subtitle_translation: 林，走个程序提醒——Apex Horizon 没提前四十八小时通知就把阿利斯泰尔拉进来当商业观察员。我们没义务给他看单台云端账单。
cues.director_note: Claire Sterling 纽约法务冷峻压阵

cues.text: [measured] Let him stay, Claire. [firmly] If Selfridges and Best Buy want to audit our unit economics face to face, better tonight than after launch.
cues.subtitle_translation: 让他留下，克莱尔。如果塞尔福里奇和百思买想当面审我们的单台经济账，今晚摊牌比发售后翻脸强。

cues.text: [understated] [clears throat] Good evening, Mr. Chen. Admirable composure. [icy polite] Your thirty-eight-gram NovaEdge Glass frame is the cleanest wearable I have held on Oxford Street.
cues.subtitle_translation: 晚上好，陈先生，这份镇定令人佩服。你这款三十八克的灵犀智能眼镜镜架，是我在牛津街摸过最利落的可穿戴设备。
cues.director_note: 伦敦 RP 先礼后兵，英式矜持压迫感

cues.text: [deadpan] Yet your retail arithmetic still terrifies my finance committee. [measured] Three hundred ninety-nine dollars retail—three twenty-nine pounds in London—less our forty percent retail margin leaves you two hundred thirty-nine dollars wholesale.
cues.subtitle_translation: 但你们的零售算术依然让我的财务委员会毛骨悚然。零售三百九十九美元、伦敦三百二十九英镑，扣掉我们四成渠道毛利，你净批发价只剩两百三十九美元。

cues.text: [interrupting] [measured] Two hundred thirty-nine point four, Alistair. [firmly] And our Shenzhen manufacturing bill is one hundred forty-two dollars today, heading lower next month.
cues.subtitle_translation: 精确说是两百三十九点四美元，阿利斯泰尔。我们深圳整机物料成本目前是一百四十二美元，下个月还会再压低。

cues.text: [icy polite] Before you celebrate, remember our eight percent co-op marketing contribution and flagship slotting fee. [sarcastic] Splendid hardware margin—until your customer actually switches the glasses on.
cues.subtitle_translation: 先别急着庆祝，别忘了我们百分之八的联合营销费和旗舰进场费。硬件毛利看着真体面——直到顾客真的把眼镜开机。

cues.text: [coldly] Your multimodal cloud API burns eighteen cents per active user every single day. [blunt] Over three years, that is one hundred ninety-seven dollars per frame.
cues.subtitle_translation: 你们那套公有云多模态接口，每个活跃用户每天烧掉十八美分。三年算下来，每副眼镜要吞掉一百九十七美元。

cues.text: [icy polite] Expensive cloud AI is already eating into budgets across every electronics floor I manage. [measured] That creates a really hard trade-off for flagship retailers to ignore.
cues.subtitle_translation: 高昂的云端算力成本已经在啃噬我手下所有数码卖场的年度预算了。这给旗舰零售商制造了一个极难忽略的残酷权衡。
cues.director_note: 伦敦 RP 清晰爆破 eating /t/，冷冽压迫

cues.text: [interrupting] [icy polite] He is asking the exact question our investment committee cares about, Lin. [skeptical] Everyone on Sand Hill Road loves bragging about frontier model leaderboards.
cues.subtitle_translation: 他问的正是我们投委会最关心的问题，林。沙丘路人人都爱炫耀前沿模型跑分榜第一。

cues.text: [blunt] Real enterprise buyers do not pay for leaderboards. [coldly] They ask two brutal questions: What is good enough, and what does it cost to run this thing a million times?
cues.subtitle_translation: 真实商业买家根本不为跑分榜买单。他们只问两个最残酷的问题：做到什么程度才算够用，以及把这东西跑一百万次要花多少钱？

cues.text: [pushback] Wait—Alistair's three-year model assumes zero software tiering and zero model compression. [blunt] You are pricing yesterday's cloud bill against next year's hardware.
cues.subtitle_translation: 等等——阿利斯泰尔的三年测算假设零软件分级、零模型压缩。你在用昨天的云端账单去给明年的硬件定价。

cues.text: [interrupting] [coldly] Forecasts are free, Claire. Cash is not. [measured] Your deck promises tremendous three-year upside on subscriptions and hardware renewals.
cues.subtitle_translation: 预测模型不要钱，克莱尔，现金才要钱。你们路演文件把三年订阅和换机画出了惊人的上行空间。

cues.text: [understated] [short pause] Fine. Suppose I buy your upside. [coldly] When are you going to get it? Because cash this quarter beats magic cash in year four.
cues.subtitle_translation: 好，就算我认你画的上行空间。你到底什么时候能拿到这笔钱？因为本季度落袋的真金白银，永远强过第四年的纸面奇迹。

cues.text: [dismissive] And without a sub-two-point-five percent defect ceiling in writing, Oxford Street keeps its shelf space for watches. [icy polite] Do you have an answer tonight, Mr. Chen?
cues.subtitle_translation: 而且如果白纸黑字锁不住百分之二点五以内的返修率红线，牛津街的货架还是留给腕表吧。陈先生，你今晚有答案吗？

cues.text: [calmly] Give me four minutes outside, Victoria. [measured] I am calling my Shenzhen factory floor right now—when I walk back in, you get live telemetry, not slides.
cues.subtitle_translation: 给我四分钟去走廊打个电话，维多利亚。我现在直接连线深圳产线——等我推门回来，给你看实时遥测，不看幻灯片。

cues.sfx_prompt: Heavy frameless tempered glass boardroom door swinging shut with a muted brushed-steel hydraulic latch click inside a quiet Sand Hill Road office suite, pure foley, no human voice
cues.director_note: 林沉推门步入走廊，切入深圳深夜产线暗线

cues.sfx_prompt: Crisp executive smartphone conference bridge dial chime clicking cleanly into a quiet transpacific encrypted telecom line hum across an empty midnight desk, pure foley, no human voice
cues.director_note: 加密电话接通深圳南山凌晨一点

cues.sfx_prompt: Precision high-speed surface-mount pick-and-place robotics humming rhythmically beside soft pneumatic air valves and optical inspection conveyor clicks inside a Shenzhen electronics cleanroom, pure foley, no human voice
cues.director_note: 电话背景隐约传来南山 SMT 无尘车间贴片节奏

cues.text: [tense] 老周，账面八千万那个坑我按住了。但维多利亚把伦敦买手请进了会议室，拿每天十八美分的云端账单和返修率红线卡死我们毛利。
cues.director_note: 私下切纯正中文，把听众直接拉入南山实战

cues.text: [deadpan] [sighs] 果然冲着算力账单来的。这群穿定制西装的家伙，眼里根本看不见产线每天少睡的那四个小时。
cues.director_note: 周默熬夜电话质感，冷峻带硬核锋芒

cues.text: [blunt] 听好了，三条硬数字直接砸他们脸上。第一，微显示光波导切到新二供后，整机 BOM cost 刚从一百四十二美金压到一百二十四美金，省出整整十八块。
[measured] 十八美金能稳住硬件底盘，返修率呢？阿利斯泰尔刚才把红线死死画在百分之二点五，而且咬死三年一百九十七美金的公有云调用费。
[firmly] 光学自动检测线刚跑完五千副老化抽检，不良率压到百分之一点八，离他那条红线还留着七个千分点的安全垫。
[confident] 更硬的是端侧蒸馏模型，四十分钟前刚过百万级压测！日常语音、实时字幕全切到本地 NPU，只有重度视觉推理才回云端。
[wryly] 单日云端成本从十八美分直接砍到四美分，降幅百分之七十八。三年账单只剩四十四块，算力吞吐效率翻十倍。
cues.director_note: zh 角色合法使用 [wryly]，呈现深圳工程师冷幽默

cues.text: [firmly] 把压测日志、良率报告和产线签字单立刻推到我镜片端。记住，他们盯着的是每副眼镜的钱什么时候落袋，今晚我把算盘摔在桌上。
[blunt] 数据包发过去了。林沉，别让那帮人拿纸面亏损吓唬住，硬件的底牌永远长在产线上，不在华尔街表格里。

cues.sfx_prompt: Heavy frameless tempered glass boardroom door swinging shut with a muted brushed-steel hydraulic latch click inside a quiet Sand Hill Road office suite, pure foley, no human voice
cues.director_note: 林沉推门重返沙丘路会议室，启动决胜反杀

cues.text: [measured] Check your tablets. Live telemetry from our Shenzhen cleanroom just uploaded. [firmly] First, optical re-sourcing drops our manufacturing bill from one forty-two to one twenty-four, with audited defect rate at one-point-eight percent.
cues.subtitle_translation: 看你们的平板，深圳无尘产线的实时遥测刚刚传上来了。第一，光学重新寻源把整机物料成本从一百四十二美元压到一百二十四美元，实测不良率百分之一点八。

cues.text: [confident] Second, our distilled on-device model handles eighty percent of daily queries locally. [blunt] In other words, daily cloud spend drops from eighteen cents to four cents—a seventy-eight percent cut.
cues.subtitle_translation: 第二，我们的端侧蒸馏模型本地消化了八成日常请求。换句话说，单日云端成本从十八美分骤降到四美分——整整砍掉百分之七十八。
cues.director_note: In other words 瞬间把技术指标翻译成单台现金流

cues.text: [interrupting] [skeptical] Hold on, Mr. Chen. [measured] Cheap on-device silicon usually means sluggish latency and sloppy translations—my Oxford Street buyers will return them in droves.
cues.subtitle_translation: 且慢，陈先生。廉价端侧芯片往往意味着迟钝延迟和拙劣翻译——牛津街的顾客会成批退货。

cues.text: [blunt] You are pricing raw chip cost instead of system output. [measured] Land power and shell, optics, and titanium frame are fixed anyway. Pick your favorite number on chip price—five dollars up or down barely moves the box.
cues.subtitle_translation: 你在按单颗芯片算钱，没算系统总产出。厂房基建、光学和钛合金镜架本来就是刚性成本。芯片价格随便你选个数字——涨跌五美元根本动不了整机大盘。
cues.director_note: Pick your favorite number 美式降维让步 + land power and shell 彩蛋

cues.text: [firmly] What wins is architecture that delivers 10 times the throughput per watt and generates the lowest cost tokens on the glass itself. [confident] Run this thing a million times, and our three-year cloud bill is forty-four dollars, not one ninety-seven.
cues.subtitle_translation: 真正致胜的是每瓦能跑出十倍吞吐量、并在镜片端产出最低成本词元的架构。把这东西跑上一百万次，我们的三年云端账单也只是四十四美元，不是一百九十七美元。
cues.director_note: 10 times the throughput 与 lowest cost tokens 终极算力核弹

cues.text: [understated] [short pause] Forty-four dollars over thirty-six months, plus eighteen dollars back on the frame. [measured] That leaves seventy-one dollars of net hardware headroom after our forty percent shelf margin.
cues.subtitle_translation: 三十六个月四十四美元，加上镜架省回来的十八美元。扣完我们四成货架毛利后，你每台还剩七十一美元净硬件盈余。

cues.text: [firmly] And to answer your question, Victoria—when do we get the cash? [confident] Day one upon wholesale settlement, before a single subscription renews. Zero phantom upside.
cues.subtitle_translation: 至于回答你的问题，维多利亚——我们什么时候拿到现金？批发结算第一天就落袋，根本不用等订阅续费。零纸面画饼。

cues.text: [icy polite] [short pause] Impressive engineering sprint, Lin. [measured] Keep your one-point-two-billion pre-money. We drop the thirty percent haircut tonight.
cues.subtitle_translation: 很漂亮的工程冲刺，林。保留你十二亿美元投前估值，今晚我们撤回三成砍价。

cues.text: [interrupting] [measured] And I will recommend the Oxford Street flagship allocation to my board on Monday, with the one-point-eight percent defect audit attached.
cues.subtitle_translation: 我周一也会向董事会推荐牛津街旗舰店配额，附上你们百分之一点八的不良率审计报告。

cues.sfx_prompt: Thick bound term-sheet dossier sliding briskly across a polished walnut conference table followed by a solid fountain pen cap snapping shut on heavyweight cardstock, pure foley, no human voice
cues.director_note: Claire 突然将翻到第 14 页的附录拍在胡桃木桌上

cues.text: [blunt] Put the pen down, Lin. Do not initial that signature block. [firmly] Victoria dropped the valuation cut because she moved the knife to page fourteen.
cues.subtitle_translation: 把笔放下，林，别在签字栏落款。维多利亚撤回估值砍价，是因为她把刀藏到了第十四页。

cues.text: [interrupting] [icy polite] Standard milestone protection, Claire. [coldly] Fifty thousand contracted units across Western retail within sixty days—or Apex Horizon assumes board veto power.
cues.subtitle_translation: 标准的里程碑保护条款而已，克莱尔。六十天内拿下欧美零售五万台硬订单——否则 Apex Horizon 自动接管董事会否决权。
cues.director_note: Act 4 终极冷峭暗雷摊牌

cues.text: [tense] Sixty days for a fifty-thousand-unit minimum order across two continents is a governance trap, Lin. [guarded] Miss by twenty-four hours, and she takes the steering wheel without paying a penny more.
cues.subtitle_translation: 六十天横跨两大洲签下五万台起订量，这是个控制权陷阱，林。只要晚二十四小时，她一分钱不多出就能抢走方向盘。

cues.text: [understated] If your hardware really sells itself, sixty days is generous. [icy polite] Take the bridge wire at one-point-two billion, or walk out before sunrise.
cues.subtitle_translation: 如果你们硬件真像你说的那么好卖，六十天绰绰有余。要么按十二亿估值拿走这笔过桥资金，要么天亮前空手离开。

cues.text: [understated] [short pause] Keep page fourteen in the draft, Victoria. [firmly] Sixty days. Fifty thousand units. When I hit the milestone, your veto clause burns.
cues.subtitle_translation: 第十四页留着吧，维多利亚。六十天，五万台。等我踩中里程碑，你这条否决条款当场作废。
cues.director_note: stability=1.0 冰冷宣示，绝不咆哮

cues.sfx_prompt: Crisp executive smartphone conference bridge dial chime clicking cleanly into a quiet transpacific encrypted telecom line hum across an empty midnight desk, pure foley, no human voice
cues.director_note: 签字完毕，林沉推门拨通南山收尾暗线

cues.text: [coldly] 老周，灵犀智造十二亿估值保住了，但维多利亚在第十四页埋了六十天五万台的董事会否决权对赌。通知产线，明早启动双班倒，我们一单不退。
cues.director_note: 冷峻悬念收尾，接 Act 5

cues.sfx_prompt: Crisp minimalist titanium smart-glasses temple haptic tap followed by a subtle ultra-clean low-latency micro-chime and soft optical shutter pulse in close stereo proximity, pure foley, no human voice
cues.director_note: 声场从沙丘路切入 Act 5 贴麦黑话拆局

cues.text: [coach] 刚才桌上决定估值的不是嗓门，是谁改写了定义。下面三分钟，我拆开今晚四把真刀，逐句带练。
cues.director_note: 零播音腔、零老师说教味，当事人贴麦复盘

cues.text: [coach] 第一刀，反杀账面巨亏。别用中式直译结巴说没亏真钱，高管原话直接定性成幽灵数字，点破只是账面传导进利润表而非现金亏损。注意尾音滑入介词，先零点八倍慢听，再原速跟读。
[coach] That loss is a phantom number—it flowed through into the income statement, not a cash loss.
cues.subtitle_translation: 那笔亏损只是账面幽灵数字——它仅仅是账面传导进了利润表，并不是现金亏损。
cues.director_note: Act 5 0.80x 慢拆（复用 1.0x 干声经 FFmpeg atempo 保音高拉慢）

cues.director_note: Act 5 1.0x 原速跟读（留白 2.4s 供开口复述）

cues.text: [coach] 第二刀，听懂欧美渠道体面压价。中式直译总喊太贵，高管原话只说算力啃噬预算、逼出极难忽略的权衡。对比美音闪音连读与英音清脆爆破的冷感反差，跟读。
[coach] Expensive AI is eating into budgets, and that is a really hard trade-off to ignore.
cues.subtitle_translation: 高昂的算力成本正在啃噬预算，这是一个极难忽略的残酷权衡。
cues.director_note: Act 5 0.80x 慢拆（复用 1.0x 干声经 FFmpeg atempo 保音高拉慢）

cues.text: [coach] 第三刀，撕碎跑分滤镜。别问客户质量行不行，真买家只抛两句杀招：做到什么线才算够用，以及把这东西高并发跑一百万次要多少钱。百万两字往下沉，慢速转原速。
[coach] What is good enough, and what does it cost to run this thing a million times?
cues.subtitle_translation: 做到什么程度才算够用，把这东西跑上一百万次又要花多少钱？
cues.director_note: Act 5 0.80x 慢拆（复用 1.0x 干声经 FFmpeg atempo 保音高拉慢）

cues.text: [coach] What is good enough, and what does it cost to run this thing a million times?

cues.text: [coach] 第四刀，吞吐碾压配现金拷问。反击单价质疑时大方把参数让给对方，再用十倍吞吐终结争论；面对远期上行大饼，一句你什么时候拿到钱就能一锤定音。最后一组，跟读。
[coach] Pick your favorite number—10 times the throughput wins. Now ask your upside: when are you going to get it?
cues.subtitle_translation: 参数随便你挑——十倍吞吐量才是硬道理。再反问你的上行画饼：你到底什么时候能拿到钱？
cues.director_note: Act 5 0.80x 慢拆（复用 1.0x 干声经 FFmpeg atempo 保音高拉慢）

cues.text: [coach] 还有两枚桌上高频连接件：把复杂账本翻译成人话用换句话说切入，自证不靠烧钱换规模则亮出资本效率极高，两秒定调。
[firmly] 今晚账本翻过去了，六十天五万台的倒计时才刚按下。明晚帕洛阿尔托私募晚宴，我们接着亮底牌。
cues.director_note: 克制收束，自然衔接 E002
